concerns.text: FR-003 mandates 'OR until the Gelman-Rubin statistic < 1.01, whichever requires more steps' (i.e., extend beyond 5000 if needed). Task T023-MCMC explicitly states 'Run exactly 5000 steps' and 'Do not abort... continue to finish the 5000 steps', failing to cover the requirement to extend steps if convergence is not reached.

FR-002 requires constructing a 'full covariance matrix'. Task T015-COV states 'If only independent errors are available, the resulting matrix will be diagonal'. While it mentions populating off-diagonals 'where provided', it lacks a task element to explicitly handle the 'full matrix' requirement when off-diagonals are missing (e.g., by documenting the diagonal approximation as a valid 'full' matrix under data constraints or implementing the sensitivity analysis for off-diagonal assumptions required by the plan).

SC-003 requires measuring variation '< 15%' across iterations. Task T033 calculates the Coefficient of Variation (CV) and logs a warning if > 15%, but does not include a step to produce a pass/fail artifact or metric that directly verifies the SC-003 threshold as a measurable outcome required for the success criteria.
